findings.summary: The cross-generation feedback archive .dev-dispatch/feedback/history.json does not exist and the live index has zero entries; no prior feedback records apply to this attempt (first review of the chain). Not a product-spec defect.

The per-run `dd run --stage-model` flag remains parseable by design: it is now purely the record→launch forwarding channel (launches.jsonl argv == record.seats, control_plane.py:732/1443). The retired surface is the server-wide `dd serve --stage-model` override, which refuses with exit 2 (STAGE_MODEL_OVERRIDE_RETIRED) — compliant with the spec's 去功能化 wording.
